2610.08621.title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
2610.08621.paper_summary: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.
2610.08621.paper_summary_zh: 最近的遊戲設計代理在生成可玩遊戲方面取得了顯著進展。<lb/>然而，程式的正確性並不保證玩家會有愉快的體驗。<lb/>我們提出了遞迴遊戲創建器，一個以體驗為導向的工具，旨在將代理遊戲開發從粗略的遊戲原型推進到有趣的遊戲。<lb/>遞迴遊戲創建器圍繞四個組件組織遞迴開發：設計者、建造者、玩家和審核者。<lb/>設計者將用戶指令和審核者的反饋轉化為詳細計劃。<lb/>建造者將這些計劃轉化為候選遊戲。<lb/>編碼原生的玩家通過程式化接口創建並執行可重用的策略，以高效收集多樣的遊戲玩法軌跡，減輕由於緩慢的基於GUI的收集所造成的評估偏見。<lb/>審核者使用精心設計的基於軌跡的指標來引導玩家偏好，並結合視覺證據和明確的文本偏好，根據遊戲特定標準評估遊戲。<lb/>最後，審核者接受更好的版本並提供改進評審以進行下一輪，完成遞迴循環。<lb/>我們的方法在GameCraft-Bench上達到了77.89的最新整體性能。<lb/>在GameASG-Bench上，它實現了53.2%的嚴格任務成功率，較同模型基準提高了34.1%，並在比較方法中達到了93.4%的最高平均運行時檢查通過率。<lb/>用戶研究顯示更長的遊玩時間和更高的評分。<lb/>代碼即將推出。
